title: document
description: A dated, verbatim snapshot of a page: an article, release notes, a pricing page. See contracts/document.md.

id.description: lowercase hex sha256 of the word document, source, the url (or locator), and content, each followed by a newline except the last

channel.description: the site or publisher the page belongs to

url.description: the page's public address; required when the document is public

locator.description: where a private document is found when it has no public address

title.description: the page's title, when it has one

media_type.description: how content is written; a reader that wants plain text extracts it

content.description: the page as the source served it, decoded to text and never cleaned or shortened

published_at.description: when the page says it was published; null when it does not say

subjects.description: the ids of the subjects the page is about, when the adapter knows them by an exact identifier

fetched_at.description: when the response it came from was received, read from the kept response

private.description: true when it came from a private stream the owner consented to

raw_ref.description: where the raw response it came from is kept, relative to the store
